title: Page 1
lines: 第一章 不受待见的媳妇(1)
京城的原家，举行了一场别开生面的婚礼。
所谓别开生面，并非格外热闹或是十里红妆那般豪奢，反而这场迎亲连喜乐都没奏、鞭炮只象征性的放了一小串，晒出来的嫁妆更寒酸到让人发笑，甚至花轿抬入偌大的府邸中，府门却连块匾额都没有。
该是喜庆的婚礼，宾客稀少到两只手数得出来，服侍的下人也寥寥数人，喜堂只象征性的挂了块红布，一般人成亲时窗扇墙壁上该贴的喜字窗花等一样不见。
这是鸿胪寺卿的孙女艾篱儿，与被褫夺了镇海侯世子封号的原墨秋，两人成亲的良辰吉日。
三个月前，镇海侯原寒山出海剿灭海寇，一向战无不胜的他居然打了个大败仗，人也葬身海寇之手。一个人人传颂的英雄折戟沉沙足该令人惋惜，但京中却有人密告皇帝，原寒山其实长期勾结海寇，分得海寇劫掠海上商旅或沿岸民家的利益，这回打败仗是两方分赃不均，导致水师众多英魂牺牲，他本人则被海寇灭了口。
此消息一出，皇帝大怒之下收回原寒山的爵位，此举彷佛坐实他的罪名，然而这个案子本就事有蹊跷，先不说原寒山英名赫赫，几乎没人相信他会勾结海寇，更别说提交到庙堂的证据相当薄弱，甚至还有伪造的书信，所以自原寒山死后，此事一直沸沸扬扬纷闹不休，言官御史们一面倒的请求皇帝重启调查。
皇帝素来忌惮原寒山在沿海的威信及军力，才会在逮到这个机会后借此收回原家的爵位，但朝廷这一波为原寒山平反的声浪让皇帝大失颜面，对于原寒山后人的处置只能格外小心。若打压太过必会落人话柄，堂堂一国之君如此憋屈，令他心气更不平。
原寒山没了爵位，原墨秋的世子之位自然也要褫夺，原墨秋虽说自小跟着父亲在莱州水师营历练，但他十六岁那年于海难死里逃生后就与母亲一起回了京师，弃武从文，在文坛颇有名声。
最重要的，原墨秋是有功名的，还是皇帝今科钦点的探花郎，他父亲已经为了一个不确定的罪名付出代价，舆论都将这件事归于皇帝判错案，将一国之君架在风口浪尖上，若要以此为由撸去原墨秋的官职，实难服众。
所以皇帝只能怀柔、只能大度，表现出他虽逼不得已夺了原寒山的爵位，心中却是怜惜原墨秋的才能，因此不仅命他任官钦州知州，由七品翰林升为从五品，丁忧夺情起复，即日上任，还将鸿胪寺卿的孙女儿艾篱儿赐婚给他。
如今镇海侯府的匾额早已被取下，在府中逾制的门楣高度还没降低前，新的原府匾额尚不能装上，下人又解散不少，加上赶在原寒山过世百日内结亲，更不好大张旗鼓太过热闹喜庆。
这场没有人敢来参加的婚礼，在原寒山丧期之内，原府只能简简单单的放块红布点缀，让整场婚事显得更加简单寒酸。
在大堂拜过天地之后，新人送入洞房，因为宾客稀少，新房就留着一个喜娘，连来闹洞房的人都没有。
原墨秋自始至终面无表情，并不因这桩婚事欣喜，喜娘叫他动就动，叫他坐就坐，一副哀莫大于心死的感觉。
要说这个艾篱儿，本身也是京城蜚短流长的主角之一。她原是个乡下村姑，一朝被鸿胪寺卿的嫡次子认了亲，说是多年前丢失的小女儿，所以迎回鸿胪寺卿府中后，不乏有此女出身乡野必然粗鲁不文、貌不惊人的传闻。
这样的一个女子赐婚给原墨秋，表面上是恩惠，事实上对于在京城有着才貌出众、文武双全美名的原墨秋，是一种污辱。
故而当原墨秋拿起秤杆欲挑起艾篱儿的盖头时，他心中极端反感却又不得不为，当盖头布落下，新娘子的脸蛋出现时，只见原墨秋瞪大了眼倒抽口气，不相信自己看到了什么。
那传说中粗鄙无盐的女子，竟生得清丽绝伦，琼鼻樱唇，一双墨黑大眼澄静通透，气质清新脱俗，连大红喜服在她身上都显俗艳了。
尤其她浑身散发出一股莫名的贵气，更是令原墨秋百思不解，这如何是一个村姑会拥有的气度？
相对于原墨秋的不情不愿，艾篱儿显然愉快多了，几乎痴迷的看着他俊秀儒雅的脸庞，只差没伸出爪子偷摸一把。
「相公！」
或许是太过喜悦，艾篱儿一声清亮的叫唤，声音之大把惊艳之中的原墨秋都唤醒过来。
这会儿他心头还飞快地跳着，都不知是被她吓的，或者因为某些他说不出口的原因。
「你可以不必这么大声，无须一惊一乍，轻言细语即可。」不过几个眨眼，原墨秋已然恢复一贯的淡然，微微抬手示意她小声些。
「相公！」艾篱儿又叫了一声，这次声量显然小了许多，不过那双美眸仍然闪着欢快的光芒。「我们终于成亲了，我期待好久了！」
期待何来？原墨秋觉得可笑，「你应该知道我们为什么成亲。」
虽然她的美貌出乎他意料，也结实震慑了他一把，但想到这桩婚事背后的真义，原墨秋仍提不起太大的喜悦。
「我知道，是圣上赐婚的嘛！」
说起来，这桩婚事算是皇帝同时逼迫了原家与艾家，原家显然不想娶一个粗鲁不文的村姑，艾家更不想与罪臣之后沾上关系。艾篱儿却似一点也不介意，真要说起来，她还是为了嫁给他，才认了鸿胪寺卿这一脉艾家的祖宗。
但这样的内情，原墨秋不可能知道，不过他很清楚即使侯府没落，自己也没了世子的身分，他个人的魅力依旧不小，至少还有不少世家贵女偷偷爱慕他，所以艾篱儿因为嫁给他而狂喜似乎也很能理解。
果然乡下出身没见过什么世面，只空长了一副美貌。
原墨秋再次确认了这一点，心中对这段婚姻益发无奈。
长年的教养令他也不想与她虚与委蛇，正色说道：「你既知道这桩婚事出自圣旨，迫于形势无法违逆，亦不许分开，那日后的相处，你我便适当保持距离，相敬如宾，各自安好便是。」
言下之意，就是此后你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥，你别来挡我的道，我也不会拆你的桥。
「你嫌弃我？」艾篱儿虽是天真，却也不傻，一双美眸都睁大了，眼中却没有对他的怨怼，依旧澄澈。「没关系的，你告诉我该怎么做一个好妻子，我学东西很快的！」
「这……」她的积极令原墨秋无法理解，但他着实不想与她牵扯太深，便语带深意地道：「你不必特别做什么，见贤思齐，见不贤而内自省足矣。」
「你这句见贤思齐的话我在书上见过！」艾篱儿先是一喜，随即又陷入迷惘。「……可那是什么意思？」
原墨秋话声一顿，虽然有些意外她似乎识字，但并不影响他根深蒂固的认为她是个草包。「所谓『见贤思齐，见不贤而内自省』，指的是见到有才德的人……我说得简单点吧，就是看到好的，便向人学习看齐；见到不好的，就需发自内心反省自己是否有同样的毛病。」
「相公真有学问啊！」又学了一句，还是从他身上学会的，艾篱儿喜孜孜的。「这是出自《论语》吧？但孔夫子说的话我一点也看不明白，下回我肯定看仔细点，向孔夫子多学点东西，应该就能学会更多如何做好一个妻子的道理？」

Chapter 1 The Unpopular Wife (1)
The original family in Beijing held a unique wedding.
The so-called uniqueness does not mean that it is extraordinarily lively or as extravagant as Shili Hongzhuang. On the contrary, there is no joy in the wedding, only a small string of firecrackers are set off symbolically, and the dowry is even more shabby that makes people laugh. Even when the sedan chair is carried into the huge mansion, there is not even a plaque on the door of the mansion.
It was supposed to be a festive wedding. The guests were so few that they could be counted on two hands, and there were only a few servants to serve. The wedding hall only had a symbolic red cloth hanging, and the window grilles with the word "Happy" on the windowsills and walls that ordinary people should have when they get married were missing.
This is an auspicious day for the marriage of Ai Li'er, the granddaughter of Honglu Temple Minister, and Yuan Moqiu, who was deprived of the title of Prince of Zhenhai.
Three months ago, Zhenhai Hou Yuan Hanshan went to sea to exterminate the pirates. He, who had always been invincible, actually suffered a huge defeat and died at the hands of the pirates. It is a pity that a hero who was praised by everyone died in the sand, but someone in the capital informed the emperor that Yuan Hanshan had actually been colluding with the pirates for a long time, and shared the interests of the pirates in plundering merchants at sea or people's homes along the coast. This defeat was due to the uneven distribution of the spoils between the two sides, which resulted in the sacrifice of many heroic souls in the navy, and he himself was silenced by the pirates.
As soon as this news came out, the emperor was furious and revoked Yuan Hanshan's title, which seemed to confirm his guilt. However, this case was inherently fishy. Not to mention Yuan Hanshan's great reputation, almost no one believed that he would collude with pirates, not to mention that the evidence submitted to the temple was very weak, and there were even forged letters. Therefore, since Yuan Hanshan's death, the matter has been hotly debated, and officials and censors unanimously requested the emperor to restart the investigation.
The emperor had always been wary of Yuan Hanshan's prestige and military power along the coast, so he would seize this opportunity to take back the title of the original family. However, the court's wave of vindication for Yuan Hanshan made the emperor lose face. He could only be extremely careful in dealing with Yuan Hanshan's descendants. If you suppress him too much, you will be blamed. The king of a country is so aggrieved, which makes him feel even more unfair.
Yuan Hanshan lost his title, and Yuan Moqiu's position as the eldest son would naturally be deprived of him. Although Yuan Moqiu had been training with his father in the Laizhou Navy Camp since he was a child, he returned to the capital with his mother after narrowly escaping death in a shipwreck when he was sixteen years old. He gave up martial arts and followed literature, and was quite famous in the literary world.
The most important thing is that Yuan Moqiu is a man of merit, and he is the prostitute appointed by Emperor Jinko. His father has already paid the price for an uncertain crime. Public opinion attributes this matter to the emperor's wrongful conviction, putting the king of a country at the forefront. If he wants to use this as an excuse to remove Yuan Moqiu from his official position, it will be difficult to convince the public.
Therefore, the emperor could only be gentle and generous, showing that although he had no choice but to seize Yuan Hanshan's title, he still cared about Yuan Moqiu's talents. Therefore, he not only appointed him as the official governor of Qinzhou, but also promoted him from the seventh rank to the fifth rank.
Now that the plaque of the Zhenhai Marquis Mansion has been taken down, the new plaque of the original mansion cannot be installed before the height of the over-standard lintel in the mansion is lowered. Many of the servants have been disbanded. In addition, they have to get married within a hundred days of Yuan Hanshan's death, so it is not possible to make a big fanfare and be too lively and festive.
No one dared to attend this wedding. During Yuan Hanshan's mourning period, Yuan Mansion could only simply put a red cloth to decorate it, making the whole wedding look even more simple and shabby.
After worshiping heaven and earth in the lobby, the newlyweds are sent into the bridal chamber. Because there are few guests, there is only one bride left in the bridal chamber, and no one even comes to make trouble in the bridal chamber.
Yuan Moqiu had an expressionless face from beginning to end and was not happy about the marriage. Xi Niang asked him to move and sit down, with a feeling that nothing could be more sad than a heartbroken one.
Speaking of this, Ai Li'er is also one of the most famous protagonists in the capital. She was originally a country girl, but she was recognized by the second son of the Minister of Honglu Temple, who said she was the youngest daughter lost many years ago. Therefore, after she was welcomed back to the palace of the Minister of Honglu Temple, there were many rumors that this girl must be rude and unattractive because she was born in a rural area.
Such a woman's marriage to Yuan Moqiu was ostensibly a favor, but in fact it was an insult to Yuan Moqiu, who had outstanding talent, beauty, and a good reputation in both civil and military circles in the capital.
So when Yuan Moqiu picked up the scale and tried to lift Ai Li'er's hijab, he was extremely disgusted but had to do it. When the hijab fell and the bride's face appeared, Yuan Moqiu's eyes widened and he gasped, not believing what he saw.
The legendary woman who was vulgar and unsalted turned out to be extremely beautiful, with a beautiful nose and cherry lips, a pair of big black eyes, clear and transparent, and a fresh and refined temperament. Even the red wedding dress on her body looked vulgar.
In particular, she exuded an inexplicable aura of nobility, which made Yuan Moqiu puzzled. How could this be the magnanimity of a village girl?
Compared to Yuan Moqiu's reluctance, Ai Li'er was obviously much happier. She looked at his handsome and elegant face almost obsessively, only barely reaching out to touch his paw.
"Ms. sir!"
Perhaps out of joy, Ai Li'er gave a clear cry, the sound was so loud that it woke up the stunned Yuan Moqiu.
At this moment, his heart was still beating rapidly, and he didn't know whether it was because he was frightened by her, or because of some reason that he couldn't explain.
"You don't have to be so loud. You don't have to be startled. Just speak softly." After a few blinks, Yuan Moqiu had returned to his usual calmness and raised his hand slightly to signal her to keep her voice down.
"Ms. sir!" Ai Li'er called out again, this time the volume was obviously much lower, but her beautiful eyes were still shining with joy. "We are finally getting married. I have been looking forward to it for a long time!"
What to expect? Yuan Moqiu found it ridiculous, "You should know why we got married."
Although her beauty was beyond his expectation and shocked him, Yuan Moqiu still couldn't feel too happy when he thought about the true meaning behind the marriage.
"I know, it was the Holy One who granted marriage!"
Speaking of which, the emperor forced both the Yuan family and the Ai family to marry into this marriage. The Yuan family obviously did not want to marry a rude and uncivilized village girl, and the Ai family did not want to get involved with the guilty minister in the future. Ai Li'er didn't seem to mind at all. To be honest, she recognized the ancestors of the Ai family in the lineage of Honglu Temple Qing in order to marry him.
But it is impossible for Yuan Moqiu to know such an inside story, but he knew very well that even if the Hou Mansion fell and he no longer had the status of the heir apparent, his personal charm was still considerable. At least there were many noble ladies from aristocratic families who secretly admired him, so it seemed understandable that Ai Li'er was ecstatic about marrying him.
Sure enough, he was born in the countryside and had never seen much of the world. He only had a beautiful face.
Yuan Moqiu confirmed this again, feeling increasingly helpless about this marriage.
His long years of upbringing made him not want to be frivolous with her, so he said sternly: "Since you know that this marriage is an imperial edict and cannot be violated due to the situation, we are not allowed to separate. In the future, you and I will keep an appropriate distance from each other, treat each other as guests, and stay well."
The implication is that from now on you take your Yangguan Road, and I will cross my single-plank bridge. Don't block my way, and I will not demolish your bridge.
"You dislike me?" Although Ai Li'er was naive, she was not stupid either. Her beautiful eyes were widened, but there was no resentment towards him in her eyes, which were still clear. "It doesn't matter, you tell me how to be a good wife, I learn things quickly!"
"This..." Her positivity made Yuan Moqiu incomprehensible, but he really didn't want to get too involved with her, so he said with deep meaning: "You don't have to do anything special. It's enough to think about the virtuous and think inwardly when you see the virtuous."
"I've seen your words about seeing the wise and thinking about them in books!" Ai Li'er was happy at first, and then fell into confusion. "…But what does that mean?"
Yuan Moqiu paused. Although he was a little surprised that she seemed to be literate, it did not affect his deep-rooted belief that she was an idiot. "The so-called 'think about the good when you see them, and introspect when you see the unworthy' refers to when you see talented people... To put it simply, when you see good people, you learn from others; when you see bad people, you need to reflect on yourself to see if you have the same problem."
"My husband is so knowledgeable!" I learned another sentence, but I learned it from him, and Ai Li'er was very happy. "Is this from the Analects of Confucius? But I don't understand anything Confucius said. I will definitely look more carefully next time. If I learn more from Confucius, I should be able to learn more about how to be a good wife?"
